AboutMe.Title: About Me
AboutMe.Paragraphs: I'm a Backend Developer with nearly 1 year of professional experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs.
My primary backend technologies are Java with Spring Boot and Python with FastAPI.
I am interested in microservices, event-driven architecture, and writing clean, reliable, well-tested code.
I have experience working with databases, API integrations, asynchronous processing, and backend services for real business workflows.
I also work with Docker, CI/CD, AWS, and monitoring tools to support reliable deployments.

Backend.Title: Backend Development
Backend.Description: Building reliable backend services and RESTful APIs with Spring Boot and FastAPI. Experienced with Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Celery, REST APIs, and microservices.

DevOps.Title: DevOps & Infrastructure
DevOps.Description: Working with Docker, Git, CI/CD, AWS, Postman, and CloudWatch to support deployment, monitoring, and reliable backend operations.

AI.Title: API Engineering
AI.Description: Working with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Redis, Kafka, JUnit, pytest, and Playwright for backend data, messaging, and testing workflows.

Descriptions: Built and maintained REST APIs with FastAPI for internal automation services.
Implemented asynchronous job processing with Celery and optimized database queries.
Raised backend test coverage from 70% → 85% with Pytest and wrote frontend end-to-end tests with Playwright.
Monitored API latency and errors with AWS CloudWatch and contributed to CI/CD pipelines and code reviews.
Developed order management APIs with Java (Spring Boot), covering order creation, status lifecycle, and order history for a logistics and delivery platform.
Implemented driver-matching for shipping by assigning orders to the nearest available driver using PostGIS spatial queries.
Built a notification module to push order and shipment status updates to the mobile app via FCM.
Integrated backend services with mobile and internal systems via REST APIs, optimizing queries with indexing and pagination.

Project.Title: My Projects
Project.Label: Highlighted Project

Project.Projects.Title: SignConnect – Real-time Sign Language Recognition
Project.Projects.Description: Backend for a real-time sign language recognition system built with FastAPI, providing APIs and WebSocket communication for live subtitle generation during video calls.

Project.Projects.Title: CalmSKIN – Skincare Microservices E-Commerce Platform
Project.Projects.Description: A production-grade skincare e-commerce backend built with a Spring Boot 3 microservices architecture. It provides secure API gateway routing, asynchronous service communication, data persistence, caching, and production monitoring, all containerized with Docker.

OtherProjects.Title: More Projects

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Online Ordering Food
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: A backend REST API for an online food ordering platform — handling menu management, ingredient customization, order processing, and order tracking, built entirely with Spring Boot.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: FastAPI CRUD engine
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: A reusable CRUD engine for FastAPI — automates REST endpoint generation with repository pattern, router scaffolding, filtering, pagination, and permissions. Supports advanced features like caching, rate limiting, webhooks, and audit hooks — significantly reducing boilerplate when building production APIs.
